tools.name: start_inspection
tools.description: Starts a field verification from a pole number and returns the complete utility record. Immediately speak its technology and registered load before asking for any field claim.

request_id.description: Unique idempotency key for this start request.

pole_id.description: Pole number spoken by the inspector, using digits only, for example 18427.

operator_utterance.description: Compatibility-only initial observation; omit in the reconciliation flow.

tools.name: get_inspection_summary
tools.description: Returns deterministic totals calculated from every persisted inspection. Use it for questions about inspection history, discrepancies, reviews, verified load deltas or external requests; never estimate a portfolio answer from the conversation.

tools.name: get_asset_record
tools.description: Returns the authoritative dossier and the complete latest inspection projection for one pole without starting or changing an inspection. Use it for questions about a specific pole, its registry, work order, field observation, evidence, reconciliation, external operation, queue state or latest outcome.

pole_id.description: Pole number mentioned by the user, using digits only, for example 18429.

tools.name: record_field_observation
tools.description: Records what the inspector reports after the utility record has been presented. It never overwrites registry data.

inspection_id.description: Opaque inspection ID returned by start_inspection.

request_id.description: Unique idempotency key for this field observation.

operator_utterance.description: Exact words interpreted from the inspector.

tools.name: assess_evidence
tools.description: Assesses one already-uploaded image. The vision adapter receives only normalized pixels and a fixed rubric.

inspection_id.description: Opaque inspection ID returned by start_inspection.

evidence_id.description: Opaque evidence ID returned by the browser after upload.

tools.name: get_inspection_state
tools.description: Returns authoritative inspection state for the current session, including evidence receipts with evidence IDs, assessments and allowed next actions. Use it to recover a pending evidence ID; never ask the inspector to dictate one.

tools.name: record_operator_response
tools.description: Records an explicit human response without creating an external action. Use DECLINE_RETAKE when no label or additional safe photo is available. Before external dispatch, use ACCEPT_VISUAL with the supporting assessment ID when the technician explicitly corrects their own observation to match that assessment; the backend withdraws any pending proposal, recalculates reconciliation, and returns the updated decision.

tools.name: 05_RECONCILE
tools.description: Computes the authoritative asset reconciliation from utility record, field report, visual evidence, verified power and operational context. It never creates an external record.

tools.name: prepare_action
tools.description: Prepares the exact replacement or review action allowed by the persisted decision. It does not create an external record.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: Confirms or declines the exact current proposal. Confirmation creates a local operation reservation; speak external success only when the operation has an external reference. Do not read or spell an opaque provider reference aloud unless the technician explicitly asks for it.

tools.name: get_operation_status
tools.description: Reads a queued, successful, failed or unknown external operation by its exact operation ID. Never resubmits an ambiguous create.
